top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Miami's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.
When someone attacks on flat, fully closed Krome Avenue circuit, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
GFNY Miami's flat, fully closed Krome Avenue circuit rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
GFNY Miami's flat, fully closed Krome Avenue circuit forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 52 miles.
52 miles on flat, fully closed Krome Avenue circuit burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Miami. Train it until it feels boring.
At GFNY Miami, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
2-minute all-out efforts on flat, fully closed Krome Avenue circuit. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At GFNY Miami, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what GFNY Miami's flat, fully closed Krome Avenue circuit actually does to you.
Base fitness for GFNY Miami. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for GFNY Miami’s 52 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, VO2max, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 52 miles of flat, fully closed krome avenue circuit in Miami, Florida, USA.
